tagline: A leading silver and gold producer with operational excellence and sustainable cost structure
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin of 47% reflecting the company's operational efficiency, a key profitability indicator in the mining sector directly tied to extraction costs and the value of produced precious metals (silver, gold, copper).

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of metals (silver, gold, copper).
kpis.description: Revenue of $21 million in Q3 2025, driven by the sale of precious metals.
kpis.signal: Stable quarterly revenue in a context of high metal prices.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after paying direct extraction costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin of 47% in Q3 2025, reaching 53% excluding non-cash items. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the last 1 year.
kpis.signal: High gross margin of 47%, indicating strong operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses, including taxes.
kpis.description: Net income of $7.7 million in Q3 2025.
kpis.signal: Positive net income despite investment costs.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash remaining after operating and investing expenses.
kpis.description: Free cash flow of $4.5 million, rising to $5.4 million excluding La Preciosa development costs.
kpis.signal: Ability to generate cash despite development costs.

kpis.name: Cash Costs per silver equivalent ounce
kpis.explanation: Direct cost to produce one ounce of silver equivalent.
kpis.description: Cash cost of $17.09 per silver equivalent ounce sold.
kpis.signal: Competitive costs within the mining sector.

kpis.name: All-in Sustaining Cost
kpis.explanation: Total cost to maintain mining operations, including sustaining capital.
kpis.description: All-in sustaining cost of $24.06 per silver equivalent ounce.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €0.28 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.01 Bn in the latest year

risks.title: Lack of technical feasibility for production decisions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly highlighted at the outset (« The Company has not based its production decisions on a feasibility study »). Moderately intense language but repeated concept. Stable trend but structural. High weight for a development-stage miner.

risks.title: Dependence on economic viability of mineral resources
risks.score_rationale: Specific warning to US investors on the distinction between measured/inferred/indicated resources and proven reserves. Technical but clear language on the risk of uneconomic mineability. Stable trend. Critical weight for a junior miner.

risks.title: Operational and metallurgical risks in mining operations
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed among key risk factors (« operational risks associated with mining and mineral processing »). Moderate language but critical domain. Stable trend. High weight for an active producer with two mines.

risks.title: Fluctuations in precious metal and copper prices
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as the first known risk factor (« fluctuations in metal prices »). Direct and repeated language. Trend up (current high prices but structural volatility). Critical weight: Q3 2025 gross margin of 47% highly sensitive to prices (Ag, Au, Cu).

risks.title: Geopolitical and regulatory risks in Mexico
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk: « uncertainties and risks related to carrying on business in foreign countries ». Moderate language but sensitive Mexican context (political stability, mining regulation, security). Trend up (regional geopolitical tensions). High weight: 100% of operations in Mexico.

risks.title: Contestable land ownership and mining rights
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed risk (« title matters »). Brief language but critical category for a miner. Stable trend. Moderate weight but potentially catastrophic if major dispute arises.

risks.title: Environmental liability and insurance claims
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk (« environmental liability claims and insurance »). Moderate language but highly regulated domain in Mexico. Trend up (strengthening environmental standards). High weight: mining operations generate significant environmental liabilities.

risks.title: Dependence on key personnel and technical expertise
risks.score_rationale: Enumerated risk (« reliance on key personnel »). Moderate language. Stable trend. Moderate weight: Peter Latta (VP Technical Services) identified as Qualified Person under NI 43-101; David Wolfin (CEO) and Nathan Harte (CFO) critical for strategy.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The company does not appear to position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation in the excerpts.
Mentions of automation are limited to basic operational improvements.
No AI-related product, service, or initiative is cited.
